output.reason: [ev-dea2079e5dc4] lists this under Breaking Changes: prior chart values enabled policy exceptions in all namespaces, and users relying on that are impacted. [ev-2bbc505de6bb] says that to "continue to allow configuring exceptions in all namespaces" the operator must set the Helm value `features.policyExceptions.namespace` to `*`. So if the operator does nothing, exceptions outside the allowed namespace stop being honoured. That is a failure kind (setting-ignored, which means mandatory work), not a behavior-change that keeps working; the proposed statement even says exceptions "stop applying", which contradicts its own kind.

correction.statement: In Kyverno 1.13.0 the Helm chart no longer allows policy exceptions in all namespaces by default (CVE-2024-48921). Unless the operator sets features.policyExceptions.namespace to '*', exceptions they relied on in other namespaces are no longer honoured.

consequence.statement: Users who relied on policy exceptions being allowed in all namespaces lose that after upgrading: exceptions configured outside the allowed namespace are no longer honoured. The upgrade guide lists this as a breaking change.
consequence.remediation: To keep allowing exceptions in all namespaces, set the Helm value features.policyExceptions.namespace to '*'. Limiting exceptions to a specific namespace is recommended instead, which means moving PolicyExceptions into that namespace.
